title: PaceStreak app — premium fitness + game layer (re-roll 2)
question: Steered: a paid-app-grade home with the gamification up front. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Flame & Rings
options.thesis: A hero instrument you read in one glance: the streak flame with three rings around it — this week vs target, XP to next level, active challenge.
materials: centre Log button in the tab bar
options.viewport: Top: streak weeks as a big flame numeral inside three rings (lime = week, flame = level XP, blue = challenge). Under it: this week's day chips, then 'Quests this week', recent sessions with PR/XP chips. Tab bar with a raised centre + to log.
options.risk: Rings are the category's signature (Apple Fitness); ours earns it by meaning 'week vs your own target', not calories.

options.label: Coach Cards
options.thesis: Home is a short stack of smart cards that each say one true thing right now: 'You're 1 session from keeping week 7', 'New PR on bench', 'Crew challenge ends Sunday'.
options.viewport: A compact status bar (streak · level · week 2/4), then the top card large with its action (Log / Repair / Join), smaller cards under it, a persistent Log button.
options.risk: Relies on good ranking logic; a quiet week produces a thin screen.

options.label: Character Sheet
options.thesis: You are the character: home is your sheet — level, title, streak, badges and stats — and logging is how you earn the next line of it.
options.viewport: Level crest with title (Novice → Veteran) and XP bar at the top, streak and week progress as the two primary stats, a badge shelf, then 'Recent XP' lines that explain where points came from.
options.risk: Gamification leads; people who switch it off need a plain variant of home.
